gaps.statement: Need for RWE on long term tislelizumab efficacy in Caucasian patients to support access and comparison
RW data on comparative effectiveness data in Caucasian / non-Asian / local populations
Need for data on optimal sequencing of IO and targeted therapies (i.e., tislelizumab in sequence vs combined with HER2 ADCs, FGFR inhibitors, etc.)
Need for combination data with CTx or targeted agents (such as CLDN18.2 inhibitors)
Need for tislelizumab efficacy data in patients who stop treatment at 24 months
[1L]: Need for safety and efficacy data supporting tislelizumab (150mg Q2W and 300mg Q4W) + FOLFOX in a JP population greater than 5 pts
Clinical evidence in patients with esophageal adenocarcinoma to supplement the current squamous-only study population
[1L]: Need for exploratory biomarker data in patients with early and long-lasting response to tislelizumab
[1L]: Need for safety and efficacy data supporting tislelizumab (200mg at Q2W) + SOX in a sizable JP population
Need for data on tislelizumab ability to prevent/delay peritoneal metastasis
Need for data at different PD-1 cut-offs (>10%)
Need for data on intraperitoneal administration of PD-1 inhibitors (combination of PD-1 inhibitors with intraperitoneal chemo or targeted therapies)
Need for evidence quantifying efficacy benefit (e.g., via OS2) in later lines of therapy (2L+) if tislelizumab used in earlier lines vs other PD-1
Need for comparative data (e.g., safety/tolerability data) against competitors PD-1/PD-L1 mAb and PD-1 x VEGF bispecifics (mNSCLC)
Need for efficacy & outcomes data by CTx treatment (i.e., cisplatin vs carboplatin vs cisplatin → carboplatin switch due to AEs)
Need for data that supports optimal treatment sequencing in different patient types (e.g., smokers vs non-smokers, brain / liver mets)
[Pan-peri] Completion and adherence to adjuvant tislelizumab (vs control arm) as predictor of long-term response or outcome
[Pan-peri] Need to understand the combination of patient characteristics that can influence treatment decision
[Pan-peri] Need for median follow-up of at least 36 months
[Neoadjuvant] Need for EFS data by surgically relevant subgroups
